Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> National Lands Ministry investigates Manso Keniago shooting that left four dead, 15 injured Source : Prince Adu-Owusu 13 November 2026 5:09pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
The Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources has commenced investigations into a shooting incident at Manso Keniago in the Ashanti Region that left four people dead and 15 others injured.
The incident followed a clash between residents of Manso Keniago in the Amansie South District and personnel of the National Anti-Illegal Mining Operations Secretariat (NAIMOS).
In a statement issued on Friday, November 13, the Ministry described the incident as deeply unfortunate and expressed concern over the deaths and injuries recorded.
"The Ministry and for that matter the Sector Minister, has expressed profound concern about the development and has assured the public that every effort will be made to establish the circumstances surrounding the incident," part of the statement read.
The Ministry also extended its sympathies to the affected military personnel and civilians, particularly the families of those who died.
It stressed that the protection of lives remained a priority and that all operations and engagements in the natural resources sector must be conducted in accordance with the law, professionalism and respect for human rights.
"The Ministry urges the public, particularly residents of Keniango and surrounding communities, to remain calm, exercise restraint and cooperate with relevant authorities to handle the matter amicably," the Ministry added.
